description: Initialize the vault with a passphrase. Generates the random master encryption key and wraps it under a KEK derived from the passphrase. Operator-only.
embedding_description: Vault: initialize / bootstrap / first-time setup. Generate the random Data Encryption Key (DEK / master key), derive a Key Encryption Key (KEK) from the operator's passphrase via PBKDF2, wrap the DEK under the KEK, and persist the wrapped key. One-time per vault. Required before any store / retrieve / unlock call. Operator-only — requires operator or operator-equivalent principal.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Vault initialization result. Contains message (status) and wrapped_key_path (location of the persisted wrapped master key).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm initialization succeeded and remind the operator that the passphrase cannot be recovered without a separately created recovery key.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: After initialization, the next typical step is vault_create_recovery, then unlock + store the operator's first secrets.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Initializes vault key management by generating and wrapping a fresh master key under a passphrase-derived KEK.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: VaultAlreadyInitialized: vault has been initialized before; use vault_rotate_passphrase instead. EncryptionFailed: KDF or key-wrap operation failed. VaultAccessDeniedError: caller is not operator or operator-equivalent.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For VaultAlreadyInitialized: do not re-initialize (would orphan all existing secrets) — use vault_rotate_passphrase. For EncryptionFailed: verify entropy + crypto library availability. For VaultAccessDeniedError: re-invoke from operator-MCP context.
